_comment: Copier -> Operations hub reporter. The contract is docs/hub-reporter.md.
OFF until the hub issues a key. With no key this block is read and then
nothing happens: no subscription, no task, no database row. Set
ODH_COPIER_KEY in the environment, or put the key in the file named by
key_file (one line, nothing else), and set enabled to true.
copier_id is configured, never derived, so moving this copier to
another host does not look like a new copier to the hub.
